deep_description_en: PLACEHOLDER — Phase 2.5 will author the 300-500 word body for the AE cell (The Brand Auteur). Theme: Artistic-dominant + Enterprising-supporting; commercial creative who treats taste as defensible business advantage. To be drafted by GPT-4o with native Indian copywriter review. The body will weave stress signals, growth edges, and identity claims ("I'm the kind of person who…") in a way that feels recognisably AE, not generic. Hinglish accents (Sharma ji, Aunty, EMI culture) appear only when they earn their place, and the dark-humor IBTI roast is balanced with a warmth temperature appropriate to this archetype.
strengths_en: Aesthetic intuition that anchors creative direction
Emotional resonance in storytelling and craft
Tolerance for messy, non-linear creative process
growth_tips_en: Lock a weekly publishing cadence even when the work feels unfinished
Treat constraints (budget, brief, deadline) as creative inputs not threats
Form a peer-critique ring to balance solo intuition with outside eyes
Build a finance literacy habit so taste isn't held hostage to commerce
Schedule recovery time after intense creative sprints to avoid burnout
